questions.q: In which year did Jaime Reyes make his first comic appearance, in the Infinite Crisis event?
questions.why: Jaime Reyes debuted in Infinite Crisis in early 2006, and his own Blue Beetle series launched a couple of months later.

questions.q: Which creative trio created Jaime Reyes?
options: Geoff Johns, Phil Jimenez and Jim Lee
Keith Giffen, John Rogers and Cully Hamner
Brian Bendis, Michael Turner and Dan Jurgens
Mark Waid, Alex Ross and Greg Rucka
questions.why: Keith Giffen and John Rogers wrote this third Blue Beetle's debut in 2006, with Cully Hamner on art.

questions.q: Who plays Jaime Reyes in the 2023 DC film Blue Beetle?
questions.why: Xolo Maridueña played Jaime Reyes in the 2023 film and is slated to continue in the new DC Universe.

questions.q: What gives Jaime Reyes his powers and armor in the comics?
options: A scarab fused to his spine
A magic amulet from an Egyptian tomb
questions.why: An ancient scarab bonds to Jaime's spine and manifests armored powers, often with blue energy from its antennae.

questions.q: In the comics, Jaime Reyes is a high-school student from which Texas city?
questions.why: The comic version of Jaime lives in El Paso, Texas, with his parents and sister Milagro; the 2023 film moved him to Palmera City.

questions.q: In the comics, which alien race originally created the Blue Beetle artifact as a weapon?
questions.why: It turned out to be a Reach device that escaped their command once the first humans bonded with it.

questions.q: Which time-traveling hero turns up looking for the artifact, only to find it already bonded with Jaime?
questions.why: Booster Gold comes to recover the scarab but ends up recruiting Jaime to help Batman take on Brother Eye.

questions.q: Which Green Lantern fights Jaime early in his solo series after his ring reacts furiously to the alien artifact?
questions.why: In the early issues Guy Gardner's ring reacts to the scarab, sends him into a fury and he attacks Jaime.

questions.q: Jaime Reyes appeared in a 2011 live-action episode of which TV series, played by Jaren Brandt Bartlett?
questions.why: In the Smallville episode 'Booster', Jaime is a shy Metropolis teen who bonds with the Blue Beetle scarab.

questions.q: Who voices Jaime Reyes in the animated series Batman: The Brave and the Bold?
questions.why: Will Friedle voices Blue Beetle in Batman: The Brave and the Bold; Eric Lopez and Jake T. Austin voice him elsewhere.
